scope: Display metadata for MERLIN's implemented fixed descriptor subset; not a complete MULPI registry.

fields.name: DFT Size
fields.description: FFT size and subcarrier spacing selected by the encoded value.

fields.name: Cyclic Prefix
fields.description: Index into the supported cyclic-prefix sample table.

fields.name: Roll-off Period
fields.description: Index into the supported roll-off sample table; zero is evaluation-only.

fields.name: Subcarrier Zero Frequency
fields.description: Frequency origin encoded as a four-byte big-endian Hz value.

fields.name: Time Interleaving Depth
fields.description: Encoded interleaving depth for this channel.

fields.name: Subcarrier Assignment
fields.description: Implemented five-byte inclusive range and channel-function assignment.

fields.name: Primary Capable
fields.description: Advertised primary capability; not modem registration or service readiness.

fields.name: Subcarrier Assignment
fields.description: Implemented five-byte inclusive range, default flag and bit loading. OCD protected roles take precedence.
